title: Skywatcher sessions: psionic calls brought benign UAP, the mechanical dog whistle brought aggressive ones

tellings.quote: however every time we did elicit a respon response. Uh the phenomena was highly benign,

plain: In 2024 and 2025, at field sites run by Skywatcher, a company that tries to call in UFOs on purpose, calls made with the mind brought only friendly unidentified objects, while a mechanical signal, a kind of "dog whistle," brought aggressive ones. That is what Jordan Jose, who says he took part, tells Michels: "every time we did elicit a response, the phenomena was highly benign." If true, it would mean the way you call these things changes how they behave.
